{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out records with invalid (negative) customer_age
valid_sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Compute the mean age of customers who converted, using only valid age data
mean_age_converted = valid_sales_df[valid_sales_df['converted'] == 1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
mean_age_converted"}
